title: Answer: a failed audit of the apparatus, or a contradicting known result

statements.text: The program rests its evidence on the apparatus, so a failed audit of its proofs, its derivations or its whale data would remove that evidence. Its readings of open problems are admissible only while no known result contradicts them, so a zeta zero off the critical line or a Collatz cycle would count against those readings.

sources.quote: the verification path exists through proof-stack inspection, operator and witness derivation audit, cetacean hash and artifact audit, and cross-species replication
No known zero of the zeta function contradicts the critical-line determination.
